cost_definition: (2 * accrued waiting passenger-seconds + accrued in-vehicle passenger-seconds) / all departed passengers

selection.rule: Largest absolute projected holding difference on adapted native prefix; at least 120s remaining; no cost or Q selection

conclusions: At this selected native state, replacing approximately60s adapted holding with0s masked holding increases cost even when all later decisions use the adapted actor.
Continuous masked continuation increases total cost further; the loss is not solely a subsequent-policy-feedback effect.

The masked actor chooses0s although its own twin-min critic and the adapted critic both prefer the approximately60s candidate. This establishes local actor/critic candidate-preference disagreement; native single-intervention cost favors the adapted candidate.
The actor extraction mechanism warrants diagnosis before further likelihood, entropy, or training-duration tuning.
limitations: One prespecified fresh demand/SUMO case and one maximum-divergence event at one training seed; this mechanism diagnosis is not a new population performance confirmation.

Critics estimate scaled undiscounted IQL/H2O+ continuation values (V7 gamma=1); their magnitudes are not calibrated passenger cost labels under adapted deterministic continuation, and local agreement does not prove global critic calibration.
